Question: For two right triangles, which of the following conditions requires using HL to establish their congruence?

Choices.A: Both pairs of corresponding legs are equal
Choices.B: One acute angle and the hypotenuse are respectively equal
Choices.C: The hypotenuse and one leg are respectively equal
Choices.D: One acute angle and one leg are respectively equal

Solution: A allows SAS, B allows AAS, and D allows ASA or AAS. Only equal corresponding hypotenuses and one pair of equal corresponding legs require HL.
